name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA allowing two parties to disclose confidential information to each other in connection with a stated purpose, with standard confidentiality, exceptions, and term provisions.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, support, payment, privacy and security, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement giving an early customer ('Design Partner') access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a product development program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: A companion SLA to the Cloud Service Agreement defining uptime targets, response time targets, service credit remedies, and related definitions.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: An agreement for the provision of professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, intellectual property, payment, warranties, liability, indemnification, insurance, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A DPA governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and a processor/subprocessor, including GDPR/UK GDPR restricted transfer mechanics, subprocessors, security incident response, and audit rights.

name: Software License Agreement
description: An agreement licensing on-premises or client-side software to a customer, covering license grant, restrictions, updates, open source software, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A flexible agreement for business partnerships involving mutual obligations, optional fees, trademark/brand licensing, privacy, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial or evaluation agreement allowing a prospective customer to test a product before committing to a longer-term deal, with limited scope and easier termination than a full commercial agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA-compliant BAA governing a business associate's use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, including safeguards, subcontractors, breach notification, and term/termination.

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum supplementing a Product agreement to govern the use of AI/ML features, including input/output ownership, model training permissions, restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
